title: CSV import with dedupe and rejection report
prompt:
Implement import_users in importer.py.

import_users(text) parses CSV text with a header row containing 'email' and
'name' (any order, extra columns ignored) and returns a dict
{'accepted': [...], 'rejected': [...]}.

Each accepted item is {'email': lowercased trimmed email, 'name': trimmed name}.
Each rejected item is {'row': 1-based data row number, 'reason': code} where
code is one of 'missing_email', 'bad_email', 'duplicate', 'missing_name'.

Rules in this order per row:
- blank lines are skipped and do not count as rows.
- email is required and must contain exactly one '@' with a non-empty local part
  and a dot in the domain; otherwise 'bad_email' (or 'missing_email' if empty).
- name is required after trimming, else 'missing_name'.
- the same email twice (case-insensitive, trimmed) is a duplicate: the first
  wins and later ones are 'duplicate'.
- A header without one of the required columns raises ValueError.

Only importer.py should change.
